name: Saeki Hitomi
source:
A freelance journalist. She is a well-known journalist who has uncovered a variety of scandals, mainly in the political and business world.

She has a strong sense of justice, and when she judges an opponent's actions to be evil, she tries to get a story that can be exposed even if it is illegal. Most of the stories she has obtained are not available in the usual way.

This time, she has her eyes on Sousuke, one of the world's wealthiest men, and tries to contact him to get clues on the dark rumors about him. Because of this, she is captured by him and experiences those rumors first hand.
